class CarbonLexer(RegexLexer):

    For Carbon source.
    """

    url = 'https://github.com/carbon-language/carbon-lang'
    filenames = ['*.carbon']
    aliases = ['carbon']
    mimetypes = ['text/x-carbon']
    version_added = '2.15'
    
    def analyse_text(text):
        # Check for common Carbon patterns
        if 'package' in text and 'fn' in text:
            return 0.7
        # Check for Carbon-specific literals
        if re.search(r'\b0x[0-9a-fA-F]+\b', text) or re.search(r'\b0b[01]+\b', text) or re.search(r'\b0o[0-7]+\b', text):
            return 0.4
        return 0.0
